question: Who was the first woman graduate of Calcutta University?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kadambini Ganguly.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kadambini Ganguly:-**

 
 
• She was born in 1861 in British India and was one of the first female graduates in India.
 
• She was also the first Indian woman to study and practice medicine in the country.
 
• **She completed her graduation from Calcutta University in 1883, and later went on to study medicine at the Women's Medical College in Philadelphia, USA.**
 
• Kadambini Ganguly was a pioneering figure in the Indian women's rights movement, and was actively involved in social and political reforms for women.
 
• She was also the first woman to be admitted to the British Indian Medical Service, and the first female physician in South Asia to practice allopathic medicine.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sarojini Naidu:-**

 
 
• She was a prominent Indian poet, and a leading figure in the Indian independence movement. 
 
 
 
• **Annie Besant:-**
 
 
• She was a British socialist, theosophist, and women's rights activist who played a key role in India's struggle for independence. 
 
 
 
• **Rajkumari Amrit Kaur:-**
 
 
• She was an Indian freedom fighter and social reformer who played a key role in the Indian independence movement.
